q_arm0_open_y = np.array([0, 1, 0, 0])           # Arm0 facing down, opening along Y

# Interpolate quaternion from q_arm0_open_x to q_arm0_open_y
# q_arm0_open_x = [0, 0.707, 0.707, 0] (opening along X)
# q_arm0_open_y = [0, 1, 0, 0] (opening along Y)
# This rotates the gripper 90° around Z

# Slerp between the two quaternions
def slerp(q1, q2, t):
    q1 = q1 / np.linalg.norm(q1)
    q2 = q2 / np.linalg.norm(q2)
    dot = np.clip(np.dot(q1, q2), -1.0, 1.0)
    if dot < 0:
        q2 = -q2
        dot = -dot
    if dot > 0.9999:
        return (q1 + t * (q2 - q1)) / np.linalg.norm(q1 + t * (q2 - q1))
    theta_0 = np.arccos(dot)
    theta = theta_0 * t
    s1 = np.cos(theta) - dot * np.sin(theta) / np.sin(theta_0)
    s2 = np.sin(theta) / np.sin(theta_0)
    return s1 * q1 + s2 * q2

    joints0 = solve_ik_arm0(mid_pos, q_rot)

print(f"Arm 0 at handover position: {final_handover_pos}")

# ============================================================
# PHASE 3: Arm 1 grasps the handle
# ============================================================
print(f"\n--- Phase 3: Arm 1 grasps ---")

# Handle end is toward +X from handover center
